title: fwf-1992-tag-team
label: Storm

how: Won the federation's own tag championship tournament final, Thunder reversing a small package so that Lightning could pin Derek Sanderson.

title: fwf-1992-tag-team
label: Devastation

won.source: the federation's own tag ledger, reposted whole on 7 January 1993 (promotions/fwf-1992/archive/fwf-tag-rankings-history-1993-01-07.html)

how: Beat Storm, Derek Sanderson scoring a flying headbutt and a three count after Hurricane Andrew Simms hit Thunder with his cast.
note: Turned back the Chameleons, then lost the unified FWF/PWA championship to Crime & Punishment at the Clash of the Masters — Punisher Lang pinning Johnny Houlton with Houlton's own foot on the bottom rope. The federation's own rankings, posted in the same document, still head themselves "Champs: Devastation"; both readings are recorded.

title: fwf-1992-united-states-heavyweight
